get.description:
**Inside the installation only:** activitypub-service asks it for the card of a link in a post that came from another server. The gateway sends nobody from outside here.

The preview as it is kept, the key of its picture included, which the public route does not give out. A request that came through the gateway is answered 404.

Who may call it: anyone, signed in or not.

parameters.description: The link: an http or https address.
parameters.name: url

400.description: the request is not well formed, or a value in it is not one it may be

429.description: the services have asked for too many lately

get.description:
Read from the page by this installation when no fresh preview is kept, so that nobody's browser asks the other site. For the composer, while a post is written.

Who may call it: somebody signed in.

parameters.description: The link: an http or https address.
parameters.name: url

204.description: there is nothing to show: the page could not be read, is not a page, or says nothing of itself

400.description: the request is not well formed, or a value in it is not one it may be

401.description: no token, or one that has expired

429.description: the viewer has asked for too many lately
